summary.en: The Iraqi prime minister has ordered the ministry to take direct control of oilfields in areas held by Kurdish parties, prompting the KDP and PUK to unite in opposition and warn Baghdad against unilateral decisions. Security forces have dismissed the border crossings chief and fired a border official, while new commanders have taken over Kirkuk operations and preparations are underway for a military withdrawal from certain cities. The government is also intensifying an anti-smuggling drive that targets Kurdish border crossings and oil theft, which has been reported across all governorates. 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
